# [Implementation] - Task Plan

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #339 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Run each block **as written from the worktree root** (a built `dist/` is a precondition — the gate list builds first). Every block creates its own sandbox under `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-339-*` — the tool's own smoke-sandbox root (issue #279: `SMOKE_SANDBOX_HOME_SEGMENTS` + `SMOKE_SANDBOX_DIR_PREFIX`, the only path the state-isolation guard positively recognises outside a test run), so nothing here touches the repository's own state, `.agyloop/`, or any CodeLoop pipeline, and no block depends on `NODE_ENV=test` to write its checkpoint. A `/tmp` sandbox is refused by that guard (`MSG_STATE_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN_SMOKE_TEST`), which is why these blocks must not use the OS temp directory. `REPO` captures the worktree root; each command runs `node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js"` with the sandbox as cwd. Sandboxes are removed by each block's `EXIT` trap.

**S1 — Item 1: `plan --skip-discovery` never names Discovery**

```bash
set -euo pipefail
REPO="$(pwd)"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
SBX="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-339-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$SBX"' EXIT
cd "$SBX"
git init -q . && git config user.email s@x.invalid && git config user.name s
git commit -q --allow-empty -m init
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY >/dev/null 2>&1
OUT="$(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" plan --skip-discovery 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Pipeline advanced to'
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q '\[PLAN\]'
if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Discovery Subagent'; then echo 'FAIL: Discovery subagent named'; exit 1; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Model Tier'; then echo 'FAIL: attribution block printed'; exit 1; fi
echo 'PASS: item 1'
```

**S3 — Item 3a: a title-rejected report is reported as a title problem**

```bash
set -euo pipefail
REPO="$(pwd)"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
SBX="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-339-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$SBX"' EXIT
cd "$SBX"
git init -q . && git config user.email s@x.invalid && git config user.name s
git commit -q --allow-empty -m init
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" plan --title 'KindGate339' --type discovery >/dev/null 2>&1
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition TRIAGE >/dev/null 2>&1
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" transition DISCOVERY >/dev/null 2>&1
F="$(find artifacts/plans -name '*Discovery*.md' -print -quit)"
test -n "$F"
cat > "$F" <<'EOF'
## Problem Statement & Symptoms

- **Observed Behavior:** The operator sees a missing-RCA claim when only the report title is wrong.
- **Expected Behavior:** The park message must name the title discriminator it actually rejected.
- **Affected Components / Paths:** src/domain/value-objects/plan-document-kind.ts title-only gate.

## 2. Root Cause Analysis (RCA)

- **Investigation Steps:** Prepended the scaffold title to a populated report and observed it advance.
- **Identified Failure Mode:** The kind reason was dropped by the message path before rendering.
- **Relevant Code References:** src/application/start-planning.ts and the park formatter in constants.
EOF
OUT="$(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" plan 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Parked at DISCOVERY'
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -qi 'first line'
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q '\[Discovery\]'
if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'does not yet contain RCA evidence'; then echo 'FAIL: kind rejection misreported as missing content'; exit 1; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Missing evidence in'; then echo 'FAIL: content breakdown printed for a kind rejection'; exit 1; fi
{ echo '# [Discovery] - KindGate339'; echo; cat "$F"; } > "$F.tmp" && mv "$F.tmp" "$F"
OUT2="$(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" plan 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT2" | grep -q 'Pipeline advanced to'
echo 'PASS: item 3 (kind gate)'
```

**S9 — Items 8/9: no ESC when piped, honoured `NO_COLOR`/`TERM=dumb`, EPIPE intact, TTY still colours**

```bash
set -euo pipefail
REPO="$(pwd)"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
SBX="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-339-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$SBX"' EXIT
cd "$SBX"
git init -q . && git config user.email s@x.invalid && git config user.name s
git commit -q --allow-empty -m init
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" status > out-status.txt 2>&1
set +e
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" next > out-next.txt 2>&1
set -e
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" worktree list > out-worktree.txt 2>&1
NO_COLOR=1 node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" status > out-nocolor.txt 2>&1
TERM=dumb node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" status > out-dumb.txt 2>&1
for f in out-status.txt out-next.txt out-worktree.txt out-nocolor.txt out-dumb.txt; do
  if LC_ALL=C grep -q $'\x1b' "$f"; then echo "FAIL: ESC byte in $f"; exit 1; fi
done
node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" status | head -1 > /dev/null
if command -v script >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  script -qec "node $REPO/bin/codeloop.js status" /dev/null > out-tty.txt
  LC_ALL=C grep -q $'\x1b' out-tty.txt || { echo 'FAIL: TTY-attached render is not coloured'; exit 1; }
else
  echo 'SKIP: util-linux script unavailable (TTY control covered by unit test T9.2)'
fi
echo 'PASS: items 8/9'
```

**S10 — Item 10: commit-draft scope, tags, length (direct probes against `dist/`)**

```bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(pwd)"
node -e '
const { DiffAnalyzer, CommitMessage } = require("./dist/domain");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
const mixed = ["skills/agyloop/SKILL.md", "docs/x.md", "src/application/x.ts"];
const scopes = new Set([
  mixed, [...mixed].reverse(), [mixed[1], mixed[2], mixed[0]]
].map((s) => DiffAnalyzer.inferScope(s)));
if (scopes.size !== 1 || scopes.has("docs")) fail("scope is order-dependent or docs won a mixed diff: " + [...scopes]);
if (DiffAnalyzer.inferScope(["skills/agyloop/SKILL.md", "docs/x.md"]) !== "docs") fail("two-.md-only diff must resolve to docs");
if (DiffAnalyzer.inferScope(["tests/application/triage-discovery.test.ts", "src/application/x.ts"]) !== "app") fail("keyword scope leaked out of src/ (E3): " + DiffAnalyzer.inferScope(["tests/application/triage-discovery.test.ts", "src/application/x.ts"]));
if (DiffAnalyzer.inferScope(["docs/commit-guidelines.md", "src/application/x.ts"]) !== "app") fail("docs path matched the commit keyword (E3)");
if (DiffAnalyzer.inferScope(["tests/presentation/cli-review.test.ts", "src/presentation/cli.ts"]) !== "cli") fail("test filename won the review keyword (E3)");
const desc = DiffAnalyzer.cleanDescription("[Phase 6] [Bug] Some operator-facing title that must lose its tags", "fallback");
if (/\[Phase\s*\d+\]|\[(Bug|Feature|Enhancement|Refactor)\]/.test(desc)) fail("tags survived cleanDescription: " + desc);
const subject = CommitMessage.create({
  type: "fix",
  scope: "gate",
  description: DiffAnalyzer.cleanDescription("[Phase 6] [Bug] " + "word ".repeat(60), "fallback"),
  issueNumber: 339
}).toSingleLine();
if (subject.length > 72) fail("subject exceeds 72 chars: " + subject.length + " -> " + subject);
const diff = ["a.md", "b.md"]
  .map((f) => "diff --git a/" + f + " b/" + f + "\n--- a/" + f + "\n+++ b/" + f + "\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-x\n+y\n")
  .join("");
const plan = DiffAnalyzer.analyzeDiff(diff, { issueTitle: "[Phase 6] [Bug] markdown-only change" });
if (plan.inferredType !== "docs") fail("md-only diff must infer type docs");
if (plan.commitMessage.toSingleLine().startsWith("docs(docs):")) fail("docs(docs) duplication (E2)");
console.log("PASS: item 10 + E2/E3");
'
```

**S11 — Item 11: the Execution Mode cell names how the run executed**

```bash
set -euo pipefail
REPO="$(pwd)"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
SBX="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-339-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$SBX"' EXIT
cd "$SBX"
git init -q . && git config user.email s@x.invalid && git config user.name s
git commit -q --allow-empty -m init
mkdir -p .agyloop
export REPO
node -e '
const { StateMachine } = require(process.env.REPO + "/dist/domain");
const sm = StateMachine.createInitial({ mode: "plan" });
sm.transition("DISCOVERY");
sm.transition("PLAN");
sm.transition("APPROVAL");
sm.transition("IMPLEMENT");
require("fs").writeFileSync(".agyloop/state.json", JSON.stringify(sm.toSnapshot(), null, 2));
'
OUT="$(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" status 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Execution Mode: standard'
if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'Execution Mode: plan'; then echo 'FAIL: plan mode survives into IMPLEMENT'; exit 1; fi
echo 'PASS: item 11'
```

**S13 — E1 + E4: the dry-run preview mirrors the reuse branch; one path, one label**

```bash
set -euo pipefail
REPO="$(pwd)"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
SBX="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-339-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$SBX"' EXIT
cd "$SBX"
git init -q . && git config user.email s@x.invalid && git config user.name s
git commit -q --allow-empty -m init
OUT1="$(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" plan --title 'Adopt339' --type discovery 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT1" | grep -q 'Initialized plan directory'
# The adoption run resolves type `implementation` (auto), which is the shape the
# audit saw: planPath and mirrorPath are both implementation_plan.md.
OUT2="$(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" plan --skip-discovery --title 'Adopt339' 2>&1)"
N="$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT2" | grep -c 'implementation_plan.md' || true)"
if test "$N" -ne 1; then echo "FAIL: implementation_plan.md named $N times (E4)"; exit 1; fi
OUT3="$(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" plan --dry-run 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT3" | grep -q 'Would reuse existing plan directory'
if printf '%s\n' "$OUT3" | grep -q 'Would scaffold'; then echo 'FAIL: dry-run preview promises a scaffold the real run will not do (E1)'; exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' "$OUT3" | grep -q 'No checkpoint was written'
echo 'PASS: audit extras E1 + E4'
```
